fusions.name: Firm Wrist Snap
fusions.desc: A controlled snap deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows the target by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Grip
fusions.desc: Coils the lash around an enemy at or below 25% health, deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure Wrist
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckled Handle
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.
